terminal_regression.execution_note: Build prerequisites sequential; two independent test processes with isolated fixture directories/ephemeral peer ports. No BBS probes run concurrently.
terminal_regression.supplemental_reason: The PROGRAM bridge FLAGS cases were added to an imported test helper after these two CPU suites had first run. Both suites were rerun against the final helper source; runtime and initial 68-command results are unchanged.

linked.scope: Actual linked AltF10 scheduler, direct process_run, child handoff, flow, UART IRQ/vector/format and video restoration. Kernel/BIOS/UART modeled. Selective live application is tested separately; link/profile changes remain deferred.

transaction_owner.scope: Actual terminal-linked far-C setup owner, real native command expansion, pure validators and near/far adapters. Only PRM read and DOS canonicalizer boundaries are modeled. No active globals, file writes, UART or video access; caller-owned output and pending lifecycle are checked. Separate live application and real DOS tests cover foreground commit.

selective_application.scope: Actual linked AltF10, DOS process owner, C file read/canonicalization, candidate owner/decoders, native expansion, modem preparation and selective application. Only DOS kernel/BIOS/UART boundaries modeled. Independent renderer/RIS test executes the real reset and screen code. All serial/profile changes remain explicitly deferred; real DOS production editor tests are separate.

same_port_policy.scope: Actual far-C owner policy/acknowledgment APIs with independent byte/range oracles. Canonical/PRM reads modeled by Owner; native decoders/expansion and bridge code execute. Permission to stage a serial proposal is not UART application; foreground choice/hardware tests are separate.

same_port_handoff.scope: Actual linked DOS foreground choice, C policy/acknowledgment, native UART setters, old-format XON/TEMT gate, ISR/video restoration and original baseline retention. Kernel/BIOS/UART are modeled. Same port only; port/profile remain deferred. Physical peer must independently match the chosen format; real DOS timer/serial tests are separate.

profile_switching.scope: Actual linked profile proposal, confirmation, strict KBD import/canonical binding, renderer/reset, keymaps, new DA responses and subsequent RIS. Kernel/BIOS/UART boundaries modeled; no product function mocked. Supported maintained profiles4/6 only, source-owned defaults rather than original profile loader; actual DOS editor tests remain separate.

port_ownership_primitive.scope: Actual linked preflight/ownership primitive, native vector/snapshot routines, PROGRAM restoration, UART traffic and final shutdown with four independent modeled UARTs. Target DTR is preserved during acquisition. Settings UI integration has separate checks. BIOS/DOS/hardware modeled; no actual DOS multiport or physical hardware claim here.

port_foreground_transaction.scope: Actual linked AltF10 scheduling, PROGRAM/EXEC return, C policy, COM/profile choices, repeat-at-commit preflight, serial/command rollback, target flow, native UART/ISR traffic and final all-port restoration. Four independent UARTs; only DOS/BIOS/hardware boundaries modeled. Actual DOS and physical modem tests are separate.

port_actual_DOS.scope: Actual DOS production PRMEDIT via AltF10; COM1/2 in both directions, shared IRQ4 COM1/3, decline, absent BIOS COM4 and combined baud/profile change. Independent INT1C samples each UART, four before/after UART/PIC/IRQ snapshots match, and late loopback peers prove fresh DSR/DA/CPR, typed payload and video. No physical UART/Wi-Fi firmware or stock BBS claim.

actual_DOS.scope: Actual DOS AltF10 production editor: cancel, baud decline/accept, color,7E2, flow and profile choices. Fresh post-child CPR/DA and cell attributes verify resumed duplex operation and profile clear/preservation. Explicit KBD target mapping reaches the peer through F1; a missing target block retains the old mapping/profile. Independent INT1C divisor/LCR samples and exact final UART/PIC/vector restoration pass. Physical UART/firmware timing remains unverified.

scope: AltF10 canonical bound editor/candidate owner with selective settings, confirmed same-port serial handoff and confirmed maintained4/6 profile reset. Strict staged target KBD import, frozen keyboard namespace, clean reset/view/keymap baseline, fresh DA and later RIS are checked. Actual DOS includes accepted/declined profile choices, target F1 mapping and missing-target-block preservation, plus prior serial/color cases. Confirmed idle COM moves are integrated with DTR preservation, coupled profile/serial rollback, independent edit retention and repeat-at-commit preflight. Six actual DOS multiport production-editor cases independently sample each UART and restore all four snapshots. Confirmed translation modes0/1/2 use separate staged table/namespace adoption while UART ownership is handed off. Connected COM moves, same-mode table reload, other/full emulations, original PCSETUP shared ABI, complete application and physical modem remain open.
